admission.claim: A reader step that lands on an XInclude element hands that live node to XInclude processing and materializes the include-reference entry for later replacement.

observe.name: the current reader node is an XInclude element eligible for XInclude handling
observe.why: xmlTextReaderRead checks reader->xinclude, non-NULL node, XML_ELEMENT_NODE, non-NULL namespace, and namespace href equal to an XInclude namespace before calling xmlXIncludeProcessNode; xmlXIncludeDoProcess then calls xmlXIncludePreProcessNode only when xmlXIncludeTestNode(ctxt, cur) == 1 for an include element.

root.claim: During include-node replacement in the no-XInclude-marker mode, the stored reference still denotes the original XInclude node after that node has been unlinked and freed.

observe.name: the processing mode that replaces the include node directly instead of converting it to XInclude start/end markers
observe.why: xmlXIncludeIncludeNode frees the include node only in the XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE branch.

observe.name: the include-reference entry for this replacement still points to the original XInclude node after the free
observe.why: xmlXIncludeIncludeNode loads cur from ctxt->incTab[nr]->ref and in the XML_PARSE_NOXINCNODE branch unlinks and frees cur without clearing or updating ctxt->incTab[nr]->ref, so the table entry still aliases the freed node.

propagation.claim: The public issue and inspected source do not agree on a distinct, independently observable propagation stage.

target.claim: Independent drafts did not agree on where this stage occurs.
